"""Bounded geometry-only construction probe; NOT a deliverable or gate receipt.

Original cake is immutable. Rebuild curbs around a 6 mm stair clearance;
clip skirt curtain against near-coplanar stair faces in its own plane.
No source element is silently dropped: skirt fragments carry source-face IDs.

import json,time,importlib.util

from dt_ai.ops.inv_xview import part_report,XviewTolerance

root=Path('C:/x/ev_t_eb1c51ca/v014_rebuild')

source=Path('C:/x/t_d94665f2/paving_ground_inputs_v4.json')

gd._curb_solid=curb

plan=gc.plan_layers(shape(d['boundary']),{t:list(getattr(shape(c['geometry']),'geoms',[])) for t,c in d['coverings'].items()},d['base_covering'],builder.SLOTS,footprint_min_area=1000.,step=.006)

stairs=new_detail.verts[new_detail.faces[np.array(new_detail.slot)=='Stairs']]

def append(points,slot,level,source_id):

        ids.append(index[key])

for i,(face,slot,level) in enumerate(zip(f,slots,lev)):

    if slot!='Skirt': append(points,slot,int(level),i);continue

    xy=np.column_stack([(points-origin)@ex,(points-origin)@ey]); poly=Polygon(xy)
    nearby=[]

        nearby.append(MultiPoint(coords).convex_hull.buffer(.0051))

Path('tmp/construction-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(rep,indent=2,default=int))
np.savez('tmp/construction-probe.npz',verts=m.verts,faces=m.faces,slot=m.slot,level=m.level,uv=m.uv)
